query:
WITH preferred_listing AS (
    SELECT l.*
    FROM listing l
    WHERE l.id = (
        SELECT l2.id
        FROM listing l2
        WHERE l2.instrument_id = l.instrument_id
        ORDER BY l2.delisted_at IS NOT NULL, l2.delisted_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  l.id AS "lot_id!",
  pl.id AS "listing_id!",
  l.qty_at_acquisition AS "qty!",
  l.price_per_unit AS "price!",
  i.isin AS "isin!",
  i.name AS "name!",
  i.instrument_type AS "instrument_type!: InstrumentType",
  l.price_currency_code AS "currency!",
  li.ticker AS "ticker!",
  li.exchange_mic AS "mic!"
FROM
  lot l
  JOIN instrument i ON l.instrument_id = i.id
  JOIN listing li ON li.instrument_id = i.id
  JOIN preferred_listing pl ON pl.instrument_id = i.id
WHERE
  (
    l.id NOT IN (
      SELECT
        lot_id
      FROM
        lot_close
    )
  );
